content:
#2 I believe you are thinking of an old version of the page category theory. That had a long list like that, which was eventually removed because it was a bit too weird, including also items like “category theory in psychology” and the like.

It also just vaguely named these different points of views, so I am not suggesting that we re-install it (actually: I am suggesting not to reinstall it ;-).

But of course what is not can easily be made to be here. I have started a list here now

  • category - Definition – Equivalent definitions

I could do more, but I leave it at that for the time being.

I am sure more people aroud here will add one aspect or other and the list will grow…
